theater: 倫巴第曼圖亞以南的布拉杜河畔

battle.name: 巴蒂斯里亞克斯之戰
battle.theater: 倫巴第曼圖亞以南的布拉杜河畔
battle.brief: 公元872年8月，路易二世與西法蘭克王「口吃者」路易在曼圖亞以南的布拉杜河畔迎擊阿格拉布總督率領的軍隊。聯軍以結陣步兵與盾牆抵擋阿格拉布騎兵的連續衝鋒，待其散亂後反擊得手，阿格拉布統帥陣亡，軍隊崩潰南撤。卡面上的埃及月牙劍未隨軍而至，陣上用的是法蘭克直刃長劍與阿格拉布弧刃單劍。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 巴蒂斯里亞克斯之戰（通行稱布拉杜之戰，Braduh）於公元872年八月在義大利北部倫巴第的布拉杜河畔爆發，交戰者是加洛林王國與阿格拉布王朝的伊弗里基亞埃米爾國。法蘭克一方由義大利國王兼皇帝路易二世與西法蘭克國王「口吃者」路易共同率領，聯軍包含兩位君主各自的親信與職業軍士、由倫巴第各城徵發的郡兵與民兵，以及自高盧與阿爾卑斯山以北南下的援軍；指揮系統以兩套王室幕府為核心，與倫巴第諸城守軍的協同靠文書與特使維持，戰場指揮權高度集中於兩王合營之處。阿格拉布一方由伊弗里基亞總督易卜拉欣·本·齊亞德·阿格拉比率領，兵員是阿格拉布王朝的常備軍與柏柏爾徵召兵，另有從突尼斯與西西里基地調來的船隊、水手與攻城匠役；其編制以總督為最高統帥，各部族首領與艦隊指揮官分領一翼或一隊，騎兵比例高於步兵，作戰方式以季節性登陸、掠奪與速退為常態。背後另有兩股不直接交戰的力量：拜占庭皇帝巴西爾一世與教宗若望八世，前者與路易二世訂有同盟，後者以築城、設港與組建艦隊的方式，把教廷的安全押在法蘭克一邊。
countriesEn: The Battle of Braduh was fought in August of the year 872 on the banks of the river Braduh in Lombardy, in northern Italy, between the Carolingian Empire and the Aghlabid Emirate of Ifriqiya. On the Frankish side stood the king of Italy and emperor Louis II together with Louis the Stammerer, king of West Francia, and the coalition they led contained the personal households and professional soldiers of the two monarchs, contingents and militia levied from the cities of Lombardy, and reinforcements brought down from Francia and from north of the Alps. The command system rested on the two royal households, the coordination with the garrisons of the Lombard cities being maintained by letters and envoys, and the field command was highly concentrated where the two kings were present. On the Aghlabid side Ibrahim ibn Ziyad al-Aghlabi, governor of Ifriqiya, commanded the regular troops of the Aghlabid dynasty together with Berber levies, and there was also a fleet, sailors and siege craftsmen brought up from the bases in Tunis and Sicily. The organisation placed the governor at the head, with tribal leaders and the commanders of the squadrons holding a wing or a detachment each, cavalry standing above infantry in proportion, and the usual mode of war was seasonal landing, plunder and a quick withdrawal. Two further powers stood behind the scene without fighting: the Byzantine emperor Basil I, who had an alliance with Louis II, and Pope John VIII, who tied the security of the papacy to the Frankish side by building walls, harbours and fleets.
people: 留下姓名的多數在勝方。路易二世（Louis II，825至875年），路易「日耳曼人」之子，844年在羅馬由教宗加冕為義大利國王，850年加冕為皇帝；他娶拜占庭公主優多基婭，並藉此把帝號建立在拜占庭的認可之上，是本場戰爭中法蘭克方的實際統帥，在布拉杜河畔親自率軍作戰。西法蘭克國王「口吃者」路易（Louis the Stammerer，795至877年）自844年加冕以來一直覬覦義大利王位，本次越過阿爾卑斯山南下與路易二世會師；他在戰後冊立其子卡洛曼為法蘭克王，使自己的兩個兒子得以分取西法蘭克與義大利的資源，父子之間的猜忌也由此加深。對面的阿格拉布統帥易卜拉欣·本·齊亞德·阿格拉比（Ibrahim ibn Ziyad al-Aghlabi）是伊弗里基亞總督，自827年起主持西西里的征服，831年攻下巴勒摩、851年拿下諾托，839年奪取塔蘭托、840年兵臨布林迪西，這一次由他親自率軍登陸並一度佔據義大利東岸，最終陣亡於布拉杜。他的兒子齊亞德·安拉·易卜拉欣在父親陣亡後接掌軍隊，日後在875年登上埃米爾之位，877年加里利亞諾河戰敗後不久身亡，死因各說不一。教宗若望八世（John VIII，872至882年）沒有出現在戰場上，卻是這場戰爭真正的推手之一：他主持修建奇維塔韋基亞的港塞與薩萊諾的城防，並促成法蘭克與拜占庭的聯合出兵。877年在加里利亞諾河擊敗阿格拉布人的卡洛曼，以及878年解薩萊諾圍的路易二世本人，則是這場戰役的直接延續者。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to the winning side. Louis II, son of Louis the German, was crowned king of Italy at Rome by the pope in 844 and emperor in 850; he married the Byzantine princess Eudokia and built the title of emperor on Byzantine recognition, and he was the actual commander of the Frankish side, leading the army in person on the banks of the Braduh. Louis the Stammerer, king of West Francia, had coveted the Italian crown since his coronation in 844 and came south over the Alps to join Louis II; after the victory he crowned his own son Carloman as king of the Franks, so that his two sons could take a share of the resources of West Francia and of Italy, and the suspicion between father and sons deepened with it. The Aghlabid commander opposite, Ibrahim ibn Ziyad al-Aghlabi, was governor of Ifriqiya and had directed the conquest of Sicily from 827, taking Palermo in 831 and Noto in 851, entering mainland Italy in 839 at Taranto and in 840 at Brindisi; this time he led the landing in person, occupied the east coast of Italy for a time, and was killed at Braduh. His son Ziyad Allah Ibrahim took over the command after his father's death, ascended the emirate in 875, and was killed shortly after his defeat on the Garigliano in 877, the cause of his death being given in various ways. Pope John VIII never appeared on the field, and yet was one of the real promoters of the war: he directed the building of the port fortification at Civitavecchia and the defences of Salerno, and brought about the joint Frankish and Byzantine expedition. Carloman, who beat the Aghlabids on the Garigliano in 877, and Louis II himself, who relieved the siege of Salerno in 878, are the direct continuers of this campaign.
kits: 先要說清一件事：卡面上的埃及月牙劍（khopesh）並沒有出現在872年的倫巴第。它是埃及自古王朝時代的近身兵器，青銅質、單刃、刃口開在凸面、彎如新月，砍入人身或盾牌後不必回抽；到中王朝與新王朝時已被直刃短劍與砍刀取代，在埃及人的手中消失了逾一千五百年。它之所以被放進這場戰爭的裝備表，是因為它代表「弧刃一擊、不必回抽」這條技術路線的祖型，而872年真正在布拉杜河兩岸互砍的兵器裡，恰恰延續了同一條邏輯的另一個分支。法蘭克方面的近身兵器以長劍（spatha，直刃雙邊、圓盤形護手、柄部穿過柄頭）為主，輔以短刀（scramasax）、重型戰斧與便於投擲的小斧，突刺與遠射靠矛、短矛與標槍，騎士另備騎矛；防護有圓盾與上尖下寬的長鳩盾（同時期歐洲戰場的大盾圖樣，例如多拉斯之戰留下的那類形制），富有的戰士著鎖子甲，餘者以皮甲加盾為主。阿格拉布方面則是直刃單邊劍與薩布羅式平行弧刃劍（sabro-parallel，刃身微彎、單邊開鋒，砍入後不易拔出，正是月牙劍邏輯的遠親）、長矛與標槍、蒙皮蒙布的圓盾，以及自北非與西西里帶來的複合反彎弓；輕騎兵配圓盾與短矛，營帳、水袋、椰棗與穀物隨隊，馬匹由海運登陸。布拉杜是野戰，沒有攻城器投入；不過其後續的加里利亞諾河作戰與877至878年的薩萊諾圍城，顯示這支部隊具備圍城、海上封鎖與遠程補給的完整能力。
kitsEn: One thing must be said first: the Egyptian khopesh on the card did not appear in Lombardy in the year 872. It was a close-combat weapon of the Egyptians since the Old Kingdom, bronze, single-edged, with the edge on the convex side and curved like a new moon, and it did not have to be pulled back out after it had been driven into a body or a shield; by the Middle and New Kingdoms it had been displaced by straight-edged knives and cleavers and disappeared from Egyptian hands for more than fifteen hundred years. It is put into the equipment table of this war because it stands for the ancestral type of one line of technique, the arc-bladed stroke that does not have to be withdrawn, and the weapons that actually cut at each other on both banks of the Braduh in 872 carry on precisely the same logic in another branch. The close-combat weapon of the Franks was above all the spatha, a straight double-edged sword with a disc-shaped pommel and a tang running through the grip, together with the scramasax, the heavy battle axe and the small hand-thrown axe; thrusting and missiles were the spear, the short spear and the javelin, and the mounted men carried a lance besides. Protection was the round shield and the kite shield, tapering to a point at the top and widening below, a shape preserved in the great-shield imagery of European battlefields of the same decades, such as the pictures of Doulas; the wealthier warriors wore mail, the rest going over leather armour and shield. On the Aghlabid side were the straight single-edged sword and the sabro-parallel, a blade with a slight curve and a single cutting edge that was not easily pulled out of what it bit, the closest relative of the khopesh in logic, together with the long spear and the javelin, the round shield covered in hide and cloth, and the composite recurved bow brought from North Africa and Sicily. Light cavalry carried the round shield and a short spear, the column had tents, water skins, dates and grain with it, and the horses were landed by sea. Braduh was a battle in the open field and no siege engine was brought into it; the fighting on the Garigliano that followed and the siege of Salerno in 877 and 878 show, however, that this force had a full capability in siege work, naval blockade and long-range supply.
tactics: 關於會戰的具體過程，現存記載相當簡略，可以確定的有以下幾點。第一，交戰位置決定了打法：布拉杜河（學界多考為今奧廖河上游）流經曼圖亞以南，是阿爾卑斯山南麓、波河平原北緣的一條東西向水道，河道與兩岸濕地構成天然障礙，誰控制渡口與橋梁，誰就控制戰場的主導權。第二，阿格拉布軍隊是從海上來的：總督率艦隊自突尼斯與西西里出發，沿亞得里亞海岸登陸，先後佔領塔蘭托與布林迪西，再沿艾米利亞大道北上，進入波河平原；他們的補給線長，靠船隊與輜重維持，遠征一旦深入內陸就必須速戰速決。第三，法蘭克與倫巴第聯軍則在本土作戰：路易二世從帕維亞與維羅納方向調集兵力，各城的郡兵接到命令後沿河谷集結，軍隊在渡口北側展開，以盾牆與密集隊形組成正面。會戰在開闊的河谷地帶進行，阿格拉布騎兵在平原上反覆衝鋒，試圖以衝量撕開步兵的陣列；步兵結陣不動、以長矛與盾抵住衝鋒，騎兵多次衝擊後隊形鬆散、重複衝鋒的銳氣喪盡時，聯軍才在掩護下以短兵反擊，並由兩翼包抄切斷退路，統帥的陣亡加速了全軍崩潰。第四，殘部帶著能帶走的船與器械南撤，聯軍乘勝追擊，收復義大利東岸與波河中游的城邑。
tacticsEn: The record of the course of the battle is thin, but a number of things can be established. First, the place decided the manner of the fighting. The Braduh, which scholars generally identify with the upper reaches of the modern Oglio, runs east and west south of Mantua along the southern foot of the Alps at the northern rim of the Po plain, and the watercourse with its marshy banks formed a natural obstacle: whoever held the fords and the bridges held the initiative on the field. Second, the Aghlabids came by sea. The governor set out with his fleet from Tunis and Sicily, landed along the Adriatic coast, took Taranto and Brindisi in turn, and then moved north along the Via Emilia into the Po plain; their line of supply was long, kept open by the ships and the baggage train, and once a raid went deep inland it had to be fought and finished quickly. Third, the Frankish and Lombard coalition fought at home. Louis II drew troops from the direction of Pavia and Verona, the levies of the cities converged along the river valleys, and the army deployed on the north side of the crossing with the front closed by a wall of shields and dense files. The engagement was fought in the open ground of the river valley. The Aghlabid cavalry charged repeatedly across the plain, trying to tear open the order of the foot by the weight of the blow; the foot stood its ground, meeting the charge with spear and shield, and only when the cavalry had charged several times, its order loosened and the momentum of the repeated charge was spent, did the coalition counterattack under cover, cut off the retreat from the flanks, the death of the commander hastening the collapse of the whole force. Fourth, the remnants withdrew south with whatever ships and equipment they could carry, and the coalition pursued them, recovering the towns of the east coast of Italy and of the middle Po.
data: 可核對的數字分三類。第一類是年代與日期：戰役年份為公元872年，通行記載的具體日期是8月24日；阿格拉布王朝征服西西里的過程自827年延續到902年，其間831年攻下巴勒摩、851年拿下諾托、870年馬耳他落入其手；義大利本土的襲擊還有839年的塔蘭托、840年的布林迪西，以及846年與879年兩度進入羅馬。第二類是人物在位的年表：路易二世844年加冕為義大利國王、850年加冕為皇帝，875年在布列西亞病逝；「口吃者」路易840年至877年在位，844年在羅馬加冕；教宗若望八世在位於872年至882年；877年加里利亞諾河之戰由卡洛曼取勝，878年薩萊諾圍城被解，880年在巴里方向達成休戰。第三類是規模與距離：關於交戰雙方的兵力，當時與後世的記錄都沒有留下可用的數字，通行說法只說阿格拉布方傾盡全力、包括海軍在內，卻不給人數，因此具體兵員只能推測在數萬量級，其中騎兵佔顯著部分；法蘭克方的作戰部隊由兩王的直屬軍與倫巴第徵兵組成，規模同樣無從核實。地理上，由布林迪西到曼圖亞的陸路約八百至九百公里，海路更長；此戰距今約一千一百五十年。兩軍的具體傷亡數字同樣不可考，僅有統帥陣亡、軍隊被摧毀的定性記載。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into three classes. The first is chronology and date: the battle belongs to the year 872, and the date generally given is the 24th of August; the Aghlabid conquest of Sicily ran from 827 to 902, taking Palermo in 831, Noto in 851 and Malta in 870; the raids on the Italian mainland include Taranto in 839, Brindisi in 840, and two entries into Rome, in 846 and in 879. The second class is the chronology of the reigns: Louis II was crowned king of Italy in 844 and emperor in 850 and died of illness at Brescia in 875; Louis the Stammerer reigned from 840 to 877 and was crowned at Rome in 844; Pope John VIII sat from 872 to 882; Carloman won on the Garigliano in 877, the siege of Salerno was relieved in 878, and a truce was reached in the direction of Bari in 880. The third class is size and distance: neither the contemporary nor the later record leaves any usable figure for the numbers engaged on either side. The usual statement is that the Aghlabids committed everything they had, the fleet included, but without a headcount, so the actual strength can only be guessed at in the tens of thousands, with cavalry forming a marked proportion; the Frankish field force was made up of the two kings' own troops and the Lombard levies, and its size is likewise beyond verification. Geographically the road from Brindisi to Mantua is some eight hundred to nine hundred kilometres, and the sea route longer still; the battle lies about one thousand one hundred and fifty years back. The casualty figures of neither side are equally beyond reconstruction, only the qualitative record surviving of the commander's death and the destruction of the field army.
cause: 打起上來有四層原因。最表層是阿格拉布王朝的擴張需要：西西里征服完成之後，多年戰事留下的常備軍與艦隊無處可去，而伊弗里基亞的財政要靠劫掠維持，總督需要一場能帶回戰利品的遠征；打穿義大利本土，等於為阿格拉布打開通往歐洲內陸的通路，把倫巴第的財富與稅源納入版圖。第二層是法蘭克方面的自保：義大利王國自839年以來屢遭登陸掠奪，875年之後的威脅只會更大，路易二世必須保住帕維亞、維羅納、曼圖亞這一線的城防與糧道，才能維持他那個已經近乎虛名的帝號。第三層是教廷與拜占庭的介入：自846年羅馬被掠之後，教宗若望八世把拉丁世界與加洛林王朝、拜占庭皇帝巴西爾一世綁在一起，用築城、修港、組建艦隊與承認帝號的方式，把教會的安全押在義大利本土的防線上；法蘭克與拜占庭的同盟條約，則讓阿格拉布的遠征變成三方夾擊之中的目標。第四層是技術與地理：阿格拉布的軍隊以騎兵與海運為骨，適合突襲、劫掠、速退，不適合在沒有援軍的情況下打持久攻勢戰；法蘭克與倫巴第聯軍有稠密的城防網與可以承受的鄉村供應，能在本土打消耗戰。當阿格拉布的遠征隊伍越過亞得里亞海、進入波河平原，兩套戰爭邏輯就正面撞在了一起，衝突因此不可避免。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause behind the fighting. The outermost is the need of the Aghlabid dynasty to expand. With the conquest of Sicily complete, the standing army and the fleet of years of war had nowhere to go, and the finances of Ifriqiya lived on plunder; the governor needed a raid that would bring back booty, and breaking through into the Italian mainland would open a corridor into the interior of Europe and draw the wealth and the tax base of Lombardy into the Aghlabid orbit. The second layer is the self-defence of the Franks: the kingdom of Italy had been raided by landings since 839 and the threat after 875 could only grow, and Louis II had to hold the line of the fortified cities and the supply road through Pavia, Verona and Mantua if he was to keep an imperial title that had by then become almost empty. The third layer is the intervention of the papacy and of Byzantium. Since the sack of Rome in 846, Pope John VIII tied the Latin world to the Carolingian dynasty and to the Byzantine emperor Basil I, and made the security of the church depend on the Italian land defence, by building walls and harbours, putting out fleets and conferring the imperial title; the alliance between the Franks and Byzantium in turn turned the Aghlabid expedition into a target in a contest between three powers. The fourth layer is technical and geographical. The Aghlabid army rested on cavalry and on sea transport: it was made for sudden landings, plunder and quick withdrawal, not for a sustained offensive without reinforcements, while the Frankish and Lombard coalition had a dense network of fortified places and a countryside supply that could bear a war of attrition fought at home. When the Aghlabid column crossed the Adriatic and entered the Po plain, two logics of war met head on, and the clash was unavoidable.
impact: 這一戰的直接後果，是阿格拉布王朝在義大利本土的攻勢第一次被明確扭轉。877年阿格拉布人捲土重來，在加里利亞諾河被卡洛曼擊退；878年包圍薩萊諾，又被路易二世親自解圍；879年再度進入羅馬劫掠而去；直到880年巴里方向的休戰達成，才換來約十年的相對安寧。長期的影響則更為結構性。第一，它把義大利戰線變成了國際戰場：877年教宗若望八世組織的艦隊與拜占庭的援軍開進亞得里亞海，威尼斯與阿穆爾菲的船隻也參與其中，加上奇維塔韋基亞的港塞與薩萊諾的城防，西西里海峽的兩端第一次被教廷與拉丁國家牢牢釘住。第二，它讓常備軍與海軍的運用邏輯暴露無遺：阿格拉布王朝有能力組織大規模兩棲作戰，卻無法把戰果變成佔領，而加洛林王朝在本土的防禦反擊可以。第三，它為往後的南意大利格局定了調：在此後數百年裡，義大利南部的語言、信仰與制度版圖逐漸成形，東羅馬與拉丁世界的交界長期模糊，直到十一世紀諾曼人登陸西西里，才把這條線重新劃開。第四，它留下的軍事學教訓相當樸素：野戰的勝負取決於能不能保持隊形與補給線，而不是戰場上的奔馳速度；這條教訓在877年的加里利亞諾河與878年的薩萊諾被反覆驗證，也正是加洛林王朝能守住義大利的原因。第五，考古上留下的痕跡極其有限：布拉杜一戰沒有留下可確指的戰場遺存，今倫巴第的考古工作至今未能確定會戰的具體地點，戰場位置多依文獻地名與河道走向推定。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this battle was that the Aghlabid offensive on the Italian mainland was for the first time clearly turned back. The Aghlabids came again in 877 and were beaten on the Garigliano by Carloman; in 878 they surrounded Salerno and were relieved by Louis II in person; in 879 they entered Rome again and carried off plunder; and only the truce reached in the direction of Bari in 880 brought about ten years of relative peace. The longer effects are more structural. First, the war turned the Italian front into an international theatre: the fleet organised by Pope John VIII in 877 and the Byzantine reinforcements entered the Adriatic, with Venetian and Amalfitan ships taking part, and with the port fortification at Civitavecchia and the defences of Salerno, the two ends of the Sicilian channel were nailed down for the first time by the papacy and the Latin states. Second, it exposed the logic of standing armies and navies without mercy: the Aghlabid dynasty could mount a great amphibious operation but could not turn a victory into an occupation, while the Carolingians could on their own ground. Third, it set the tone of southern Italy for what followed: over the centuries that came, the linguistic, confessional and institutional map of the peninsula's south took shape, and the frontier between Byzantium and the Latin world remained blurred for a long time, until the Normans landed in Sicily in the eleventh century and the line was drawn afresh. Fourth, the military lesson it leaves is plain: what decided a battle in the open field was the keeping of order and of the supply line, not the speed of riding across it; that lesson was tested again and again on the Garigliano in 877 and at Salerno in 878, and it is why the Carolingians held Italy. Fifth, the archaeological trace is extremely slight: no site of the battle at Braduh can be pointed to with certainty, the archaeology of Lombardy has not fixed the exact place of the engagement, and its location is largely inferred from the documentary name of the river and the line of the watercourse.
result: 872年8月24日，布拉杜之戰以法蘭克與倫巴第聯軍的勝利告終：阿格拉布軍隊在會戰中被擊潰，總督易卜拉欣·本·齊亞德陣亡，殘部帶著能帶走的船與器械南撤，義大利東岸與波河中游的城邑接連收復，而法蘭克一方沒有付出圍城的代價，也沒有捲入攻城戰的泥潭。戰果在軍事上確實顯赫：阿格拉布王朝失去了最有經驗的一位統帥，其在大陸擴張的窗口被推回海峽那一側，聯軍則重新掌握了波河平原的戰略主動。不過戰爭並未因此收束：875年路易二世在布列西亞病逝，他的兩個兒子蘭伯特與貝倫加先後在義大利爭位，877年阿格拉布人捲土重來、在加里利亞諾河被卡洛曼擊敗，878年圍攻薩萊諾又被路易二世本人解圍，879年進入羅馬掠奪，直到880年的巴里休戰才換來約十年喘息。對阿格拉布王朝而言，這是一場得不償失的遠征；對加洛林王朝而言，則是一次成功的防禦反擊，把前線從亞得里亞海岸推回加里利亞諾河。作為兵器文化的註腳：卡面上的埃及月牙劍並未出現在倫巴第，它在埃及被直刃劍取代已逾一千五百年；它留在這場戰役的位置，是作為「弧刃一擊不回抽」這條技術路線的起點，而872年真正在布拉杜河兩岸互砍的，是法蘭克人的直刃長劍與阿格拉布人的弧形單刃劍。
resultEn: On the 24th of August of the year 872 the battle of Braduh ended in a victory for the Frankish and Lombard coalition: the Aghlabid army was broken in the engagement, the governor Ibrahim ibn Ziyad was killed, the remnants withdrew south with whatever ships and equipment they could carry, the towns of the east coast of Italy and of the middle Po were recovered one after another, and the Franks paid no price in a siege and were not drawn into the mud of a siege war. The result was indeed substantial in military terms: the Aghlabid dynasty lost its most experienced commander, its window for expansion onto the mainland was pushed back to the far side of the channel, and the coalition regained the strategic initiative in the Po plain. The war, however, was not thereby closed. Louis II died of illness at Brescia in 875, and his two sons Lambert and Berengar disputed Italy in turn; the Aghlabids came back in 877 and were defeated on the Garigliano by Carloman, surrounded Salerno in 878 and were again relieved by Louis II himself, entered Rome to plunder in 879, and it was the truce of Bari in 880 that brought about ten years of respite. For the Aghlabid dynasty it was a raid that cost more than it brought; for the Carolingians it was a successful counterattack on their own ground that pushed the front from the Adriatic coast back to the Garigliano. As a note on the culture of arms: the Egyptian khopesh on the card never came to Lombardy, having been displaced in Egypt by straight-edged swords more than fifteen hundred years earlier; the place it holds in this battle is that of the starting point of the line of technique that strikes with a curved blade and does not withdraw, while the blades that actually met on the banks of the Braduh in 872 were the straight spatha of the Franks and the curved single-edged swords of the Aghlabids.
